Maintain teal hood face wrap bronze clasps twin bronze grips with TWO WATER WHIPS. Left CAST: arms raised with blue water whips coiled closely around raised grips, skill focus above shoulders. Right ATTACK: torso upright centered, right arm extended SCREEN-RIGHT releasing a held water-whip lash, single continuous thin blue whip curves back alongside his arm to stay in panel; other whip held low in other hand. NO separate projectile/wave/beam/slash or scenery. Both adult 6 heads tall, feet visible, each character fits entirely into its own half with a LARGE transparent 15% center gutter, no overlap. Figure height 80% image, weapon width constrained. Clear 5% outer margins, no text/shadows/ground. Same costume/face/prop, broad painted planes, brighter key teal-grey folds and #9fe8ff directional rim, edge luminance >=0.30 on dark basalt0.16. All held water weapons intact; no detached water droplets.
